location: Experiment 1, Method > Participants (p. 8) and Results > Conditional Stimulus Valence Evaluations (pp. 18-19)
quote: evaluation data of three participants and the electrodermal responses of one participant were lost due problems with the recording device. These participants were included in the analyses of all remaining measures.
reason: Experiment 1 recruited 36 participants across two groups and lost continuous valence evaluation data for 3 participants (while retaining the 1 contingency-unaware participant in the reported analyses), yielding an analytic sample of N = 33 that matches the residual df = 31 in the two-group valence ANOVAs, F(1, 31). The shipped value of 32 likely resulted from adding df1 + df2 (1 + 31) instead of accounting for the two between-subjects groups.
